title: Cloud Yatra — Grafana Cloud alert recommendations
note: Use these as managed Grafana alert rules after mapping the Prometheus and Loki data sources. Keep evaluation windows and labels bounded.

rules.title: Cloud Yatra API 5xx
rules.purpose: Detect server-side API failures affecting gameplay and telemetry.

rules.title: Cloud Yatra API latency
rules.purpose: Detect slow API requests without paging on normal short spikes.

rules.title: Cloud Yatra low client FPS
rules.purpose: Detect a poor player experience without treating one slow device as an incident.

rules.title: Guru Megh Bedrock fallbacks
rules.purpose: Observe AI availability and cost-guard activity; fallback never blocks gameplay.
